_about: GUARDRAIL-DEMO (not for normal use). Overlay on config/experiments.json, selected with RP_CONFIG_PROFILE=guardrail-demo-latency. Keeps the expected HTTP 500 (so errors do not trip first) but caps the fault-window latency p95 at 1000 ms instead of 7500 ms. Targets, mechanism and durations are unchanged.

dependency_failure.description: GUARDRAIL-DEMO latency: stop influxDB with a deliberately tight 1000 ms latency cap; the first slow poll must trip the latency guard.
expected_symptoms: GUARDRAIL-DEMO: a fault-window poll slower than 1000 ms trips guardrail_latency and the run rolls back
